claim.summary: Over any field, in the multilinear ring with G=F[x]/(x_v^2) and C a degree-D pseudoideal, the top parts T of members of C form a graded pseudoideal of G, and fE in C gives top(f)top(E) in T. Within the window deg f + max e_j <= D, a surviving common killer whose leading form lies in T reduces, by subtracting a member with the same top part, to a lower-degree surviving killer; so every surviving killer has degree at least beta', the least degree of g in G outside T with g top(E_j) in T for all j. If 1 - sum a_j E_j lies in C, no common killer of degree <= D - max e_j survives; beta' can miss this, since the graded algebra drops the constant term of inhomogeneous axioms.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer after a failed first draft (whose survival remark was false) and a follow-up; the reduction (c) is the reviewer's correction.

The first six sets could only give 1 = 1 (controls). The constant-error control gives none for both.

claim.summary: Over any field, for a down-set X of {0,1}^N the associated graded algebra of the functions on X under the degree filtration is the face ring of X modulo the squares, with socle spanned by the facets; so it has a perfect graded pairing, the hypothesis of prop:frobenius-marked-separation, exactly when X has one facet (a standard computation). Product domains with one-hot coordinates are such down-sets, of socle dimension prod max(|A_j|-1,1), Gorenstein exactly when every |A_j|<=2; the hole-respecting assignments of the product pigeonhole system with m>=2 pigeons have no such pairing. Graded annihilation bounds domain killers from below: fE=0 on X gives lead(f)lead(E)=0 in the graded algebra, while a graded annihilator need not lift (x_[N] on the cube); on the cube both least degrees for monomial errors are the transversal number.
claim.assessment: Working proof of a standard computation, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with a follow-up; the leading-form direction and the non-lifting example are its corrections.

claim.summary: Over any field, on a finite product domain X = prod_j A_j (nonempty factors) with base states and one-hot variables x_(j,a) for non-base a (degree = least polynomial degree in them), a nonzero function vanishing on a union of cylinders (partial assignments) has degree at least the transversal number of their coordinate sets; if every coordinate of a least transversal T has a state no cylinder assigns there, the product of those state indicators (each of degree <=1) attains it. On the hole-respecting assignments of the product pigeonhole system, with base state empty, the least degree of a nonzero function vanishing on the supports of monomial errors on distinct holes is the transversal number of their hole sets, which is the least degree of a surviving common killer of 1 when tau<=K and K+e is inert, or D=n with K+e<=n and K<=n-1; for tau>K there is none of degree <=K.

claim.summary: Exact F2 computation with tools/pc_closure.py on the functional pigeonhole system (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms): refutation degree 3 at 3 and 4 holes and 4 at 5 holes; at 6 pigeons, 5 holes, D=3, K=1 (dim V_1=31, C cap V_1 the 6 pigeon axioms), for factor sets {x00,x10}, {x00,x01}, {x00,x11}, {x00,x11,x22}, {x00,x11,x22,x33} the common kernel of the factor maps has dimension 11, 9, 8, 6, 6 and equals the common kernel in the closure of the monomial axioms alone (dimension 5, 4, 2, 0, 0) plus C cap V_1. A positive control (monomial axioms ab, bz, linear axiom w+a+z, D=2, F={w}) gives 3 against 2, so linear axioms can transport killers and the equality is not generic. At 7 pigeons and 6 holes (proper at D=3, dim V_1=43, C cap V_1 the 7 pigeon axioms) the same sets give 13, 11, 9, 7, 7 against Ann_H 6, 5, 2, 0, 0 plus the relations, again equal.
